title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Exodus 3: the burning bush, God's call to Moses and the name "I AM WHO I AM".

questions.text: Whose flock was Moses keeping when he came to God's mountain?
questions.explanation: Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian.

answers.text: Aaron's
Jethro's
Pharaoh's
Laban's

questions.text: What was the name of God's mountain where Moses came?
questions.explanation: Moses led the flock to the back of the wilderness and came to God's mountain, to Horeb.

answers.text: Horeb
Carmel
Moriah
Nebo

questions.text: What was unusual about the bush Moses saw?
questions.explanation: The bush burned with fire, but the bush was not consumed, so Moses went to see why it was not burned.

answers.text: It bloomed in the middle of the desert
It was covered with snow
It glowed only at night
It burned but was not consumed

questions.text: Why was Moses told to take off his sandals?
questions.explanation: God said, "Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground."

answers.text: His sandals were unclean from the flock
He was about to enter a tent
The place he stood on was holy ground
He had to walk through water

questions.text: Why did Moses hide his face?
questions.explanation: When God said he was the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.

answers.text: He was afraid to look at God
The fire was too hot
The sun was in his eyes
He was ashamed of killing the Egyptian

questions.text: How does God describe the land he will bring his people into?
questions.explanation: God says he will bring them up to a good and large land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

answers.text: A land of fountains and rivers
A land of gold and silver
A land of rest by the sea
A land flowing with milk and honey

questions.text: What sign did God give Moses that he had sent him?
questions.explanation: God said that when Moses had brought the people out of Egypt, they would serve God on this mountain.

answers.text: Pharaoh would bow down to Moses
They would serve God on this mountain
The river would turn to blood
Moses' staff would bud and bloom

questions.text: What did God say when Moses asked what his name was?
questions.explanation: God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM," and told him to say, "I AM has sent me to you."

answers.text: "The Mighty One of Egypt"
"The God of the river"
"I AM WHO I AM"
"The Lord of the bush"

questions.text: What were Moses and the elders to ask the king of Egypt?
questions.explanation: They were to ask, "Please let us go three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God."

answers.text: To be given the land of Goshen as their own
To be paid wages for their work
To be allowed to build a temple in Egypt
To go three days' journey into the wilderness to sacrifice

questions.text: What would every Israelite woman ask of her neighbor?
questions.explanation: Every woman would ask her neighbor for jewels of silver, jewels of gold and clothing, and so they would plunder the Egyptians.

answers.text: Bread and water for the journey
Jewels of silver and gold, and clothing
Sheep and goats for sacrifice
Tents for the wilderness
